overview.text: Evelyn Mendez Avdalyan is a trustee on the Los Nietos School District board. She was elected in 2018, and her term ends in December 2026. She was first appointed to the board in 2016 to fill a vacancy. Before her appointment, she was a parent volunteer in the district. She works as a legal assistant. She served as board vice-president in 2018.
